future.updateNotice: Offensive baselines and defensive matchup ratings refreshed through Week 5. Snap history retains its original date; K/DEF team context has separately reported feature cutoffs.
future.defenseMethod: Position-specific fantasy points allowed, adjusted for opposing offenses using other games; six-game neutral prior, league-centered factors capped at +/-10%. Descriptive matchup estimates, not validated injury probabilities.

weekly.note: Rolled from saved future scenarios; model and stats dates are unchanged. Current roster statuses refreshed via Flaim.

model.note: Conditional points per active game from completed weeks. Not weekly predictions; injury, bye, matchup and role changes are not adjusted. Name fallbacks are exact and conservative, not probabilistic.
